snippet.title: Investigative Genealogist Answers DNA Questions | Tech Support | WIRED
snippet.description:
_Finding Your Roots_ lead genetic genealogist CeCe Moore joins WIRED to answer the internet’s burning questions about genealogy. Can a person’s innocence or guilt be proven through Ancestry.com? What cases have been solved with the help of genetic genealogy? How do the police find someone from a DNA sample? Answers to these questions and many more await on Genealogy Support.

WIRED recommends:
https://youtu.be/C3T_IaIGQxo
https://youtu.be/HdwzJLTLFqc
https://youtu.be/qPKHna_P9zE

Watch more from WIRED | Tech Support: https://www.youtube.com/show/VLPLibNZv5Zd0dwIx8baZGDdkoPNg6LHAPDi?sbp=QAE%3D

_Stream the latest season of Finding Your Roots with PBS Passport, the PBS app, or on PBS.org now._

#DNA #Genetics #Genealogy

00:11 - Mama Said Knock You Out
00:47 - A family tree with some shady spots
01:47 - Your Honor, I’m genetically innocent
03:10 - Luke, I’m not your father
04:21 - Genealogy: Where the answer to one problem leads to two more
05:08 - You can run, but you can’t hide your base pairs
05:59 - The circle of life
07:21 - Icelandic family trees are deep-rooted
08:55 - Ethnicity ❌ Biolographical ancestry ✅
09:54 - In the end, it’s all relative
10:30 - I got, I got, I got, I got—loyalty, got royalty inside my DNA
11:26 - Somewhere between 30 minutes and 8 years
12:11 - I get my humor from a subset of my ancestors
13:12 - DNAmaxxing
13:48 - Chromosomes never lie, they always align
15:05 - My first cousin gets his looks from my 12.5%

snippet.title: The True Story That Still Haunts New Jersey
snippet.description:
The American Dream promises safety, independence, and the pride of owning your own home. But what if your home isn’t as private as you think?

In this episode of Weird History's Graveyard Shift we dive into the chilling true stories of “The Watcher” a mysterious figure stalking one family's home from the shadows. So lock your doors, close your blinds, and don’t forget… someone might already be watching.

Have you ever felt like someone was watching you when you thought you were alone? Let us know in the comments. 

Be sure to subscribe to the Weird History Newsletter: https://bit.ly/WeirdHistoryNews

snippet.title: ❄️ Why Didn’t the Winter Olympics REALLY Exist at First? #Shorts
snippet.description:
The Winter Olympics are one of the biggest sporting events in the world — but they almost didn’t exist at all.

This quick explainer breaks down why winter sports were originally left out of the Olympic Games, what changed in 1924, and how snow and ice finally earned their own worldwide stage — all in clear, kid-friendly language.

Perfect for curious kids of all ages, homeschool families, and classrooms learning about history, global events, and international competition.

👉 Watch the full Curious Professors episode for the complete story!
